Mira: Quick sync — Lodestar12b int6 smoke results are posted, can folks scan for product-impacting regressions? https://ci.internal/lodestar/int6/artifacts :eyes:

Alex: TL;DR: int6 gives ~2.6x token-cost reduction vs fp16, median latency slightly better for short seqs but p95 up ~18ms. Automated GTN testset: macro-accuracy -1.4%, rouge-L -0.9%. No mass hallucination spikes in synthetic trace.

Sam: Do we have human-sample diffs? Which slices look worst?

Olga: Short dump from the smoke run (slice-level deltas):
```
slice                | count | acc_delta | rougeL_delta | tail_errs
---                  | ---   | ---       | ---          | ---
named-entities       | 480   | -3.9%     | -2.1         | 0.8%
long-context-faqs    | 210   | -0.7%     | -0.2         | 0.0%
code-formatting      | 120   | -0.3%     | +0.1         | 0.0%
slot-filling         | 330   | -1.1%     | -0.6         | 0.2%

overall (sample)     | 1140  | -1.4%     | -0.9         | 0.3%
```
Notes: biggest hit on named-entities (NER style).

Keon (prod): Thanks — product context: NER failures are higher-visibility for our search-snippets and entity-linking flows. What's the expected per-10k-request cost delta if we flip traffic?

Alex: Ballpark numbers: fp16 token cost ~$0.012 / 1k toks, int6 ~ $0.0046 / 1k toks => ~ $0.0074 / 1k tokens saved. For our current mix (~3.4k tokens per request) that's ~ $0.025 saved per request. If we route 100k qps-day -> ~ $2.5k/day savings. Caveats: cache hit & batching materially change this.

Mira: Product asks: recommend rollout plan. My take: start with shadow/analytics-only routing for 25% traffic for 72h with strict signal checks (NER precision/recall, hallucination, latency p95). If pass, stagger 2x -> 50% then gated full. For any NER slice regression >2.5% absolute, auto rollback.

Sam: For GTN/marketing: what's the expected user-visible delta? If NER drops by ~4% on small slice, will users notice? we need examples to hand to PMs.

Olga: I sampled 12 user queries from the NER slice — 8/12 ok but 4 had missing entity spans or subtle label shifts. Two were clear UX regressions (search snippet lost product name). I can paste diffs in drive.

Keon (prod): Suggestion: hybrid routing — route non-NER flows to int6 aggressively, keep NER-sensitive routes pinned to fp16. Also add a small post-request re-score using fp16 for top-3 candidate entities when entity confidence < 0.6. That gives most savings while protecting UX.

Alex: Engineering notes: we can add a routing flag per-route + a cheap re-score microcall. Engineering cost ~2 sprint-days to wire flags + safety gates, re-score ~3 days (we can reuse existing kvcache microcall pattern).

Mira: Ops checklist for a 25% shadow -> active pilot:
- start shadow int6 for 25% (analytics-only)
- enable slice signals (NER precision/recall, hallucination rate, p95 latency)
- run 72h, review with product
- if NER delta <= 2.5% and p95 latency within SLO -> 50% live canary
- add hybrid routing rules + rescoring if product agrees

Sam: For GTN comms: propose framing — "~2.6x cost improvement with minimal overall quality delta; targeted safety for entity-sensitive features keeps UX stable." Would attach 3 anonymized failure examples.

Olga: One more datapoint: quantization variant int6b (slightly different perf profile) reduced named-entity hit to -2.1% but cost benefit slightly smaller (~2.3x). Could be a compromise.

Alex: Agreed — propose two candidate tracks: (A) int6b hybrid routing (lower cost saving, lower risk), (B) full int6 staged rollout (higher saving, higher initial slice risk).

deploy-bot: Started shadow deployment lodestar12b-int6 -> cluster:prod-int (sha: abcdef123) at 3188888899

Mira: OK action items: Olga attach sample diffs + drive link, Alex make rough cost model per route, Keon confirm which routes are NER-sensitive, Sam prepare 3 anonymized examples for GTN. I'll own the rollout doc and gate thresholds. :thumbsup:

Keon (prod): I can get route map by EOD and flag the top 10 NER-sensitive ones.

Sam: I can prep comms and examples tomorrow morning.

Olga: Uploading diffs now -> https://drive.internal/lodestar/int6/diffs

Mira: Thanks team — we'll reconvene after 72h smoke window.
